name: Windmill Meadow
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #16 — the circuit's first MOVER: the proven 4670w three-island / 680px-gap flagship skeleton, with ONE NON-LETHAL pendulum (a lazy hay swing) sweeping the A<->B gap. The pendulum never kills (moving_hazard = a directional shove capped at ~700px/s, no hitstun); the void is the only killer. It just knocks a crossing player off their line, so timing the boost around the swing is the new wrinkle before the jump into the hazard circuits. One spring throne over C.

GEOMETRY: A (trampoline x0..900 top1080) / B (bubblegum x1580..2480 top1080) / C (trampoline x3160..4060 top1080), two 680px void gaps (A->B x900..1580, B->C x2480..3160). One spring THRONE (x3640..4020 top560 h48) hovers 520px above C. ONE non-lethal pendulum (pivot x1240 y300, arm 700, arc 150 deg, period 3.4, dwell .24) sweeps low over the A->B gap. Full-width lethal void (rim y1260); bounds -600..4670, ~600px side runway; bottom y1878 leaves ~670px recovery sky.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~320 bubblegum / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses a 680px gap in ~0.9-1.0s @ ~26 fuel, bounce refunds +20; super 2800 clears all):
- GAP A->B (with the swing) and B->C: each 680px over void. >> 527 max spring drift and >> 395/320 drift. NORMAL BOOST REQUIRED both ways; the pendulum shoves a mistimed crossing off-line into the void. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top560): 520px above C (1080). Trampoline apex 270 reaches y810 -> 270px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED; SUPER earns it. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: island bottom (1192-1208) to bottom blast (1878) = ~670-686px recovery sky (>= 650). Verb: FLY.
- Both gaps exceed a spring bounce's reach and the throne sits above spring apex; the pendulum is a shove, not a lethal hazard, so flight is still required and the void is still the only killer. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.

BACKDROP NOTE: the plan lists an optional new meadow_bloom painting; ships JSON-ONLY today on meadow_day (blue sky + clouds + hills), the art is a later polish swap.
